user.description: Enter the address of a HeatLink head.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname, for example 192.168.1.50 or heatlink-6dac.local.

token.title: Connect {name}
token.description: On the head's web page ({url}) open **Settings → API Access**, create an integration token and paste it here. With **Full admin** access Home Assistant can also manage firmware updates, off-at-setpoint, Tandem and the activity log; **Climate control** only controls the unit.

group_confirm.title: Add {name}
group_confirm.description: {name} ({host}) shares the outdoor unit {label} with {peer}, which is already set up. Home Assistant will use {peer} to create a token on {name} for you.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {name} was rejected. Create a new integration token on the head's web page ({url}) under **Settings → API Access**.

reconfigure.description: Change the address of this HeatLink head.

error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected. Check that it was copied completely and hasn't been revoked.
error.firmware_too_old: This head's firmware is too old. Update it to 1.5.2 or later from its web page.
error.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different HeatLink head.

abort.firmware_too_old: This head's firmware is too old. Update it to 1.5.2 or later from its web page.
abort.not_heatlink: This device is not a HeatLink head.

data_description.fast_poll: Read the unit every 5 seconds instead of every 10.
data_description.remote_temp_entity: Send this sensor's temperature to the unit as the room temperature. Ignored while the head has its own Bluetooth room sensors.

state.checking: Checking if the room needs a turn

scope.message: The token doesn't allow this. Use an admin token.

firmware_too_old.message: The head's firmware is too old for this integration. Update it to 1.5.2 or later.

wrong_device.message: {host} is now a different head ({uid}); waiting for this head to be found again.

update_busy.message: A firmware update is already running.

update_timeout.message: Timed out waiting for the firmware update.

mqtt_discovery.title: {name} is also announced over MQTT
mqtt_discovery.description: {name} still publishes MQTT discovery, so Home Assistant shows it twice. Once the HeatLink integration's entities work for you, open {url}, go to **Settings → MQTT / Home Assistant**, turn off **Home Assistant discovery** and select **Save & reboot**. The MQTT entities are then removed.

remote_temp_owned.title: {name} ignores the room temperature sensor
remote_temp_owned.description: {name} has its own Bluetooth room sensors, so it won't accept {entity}. Remove the sensor from the integration options, or unpair the head's Bluetooth sensors.

update_failed.title: Firmware update of {name} didn't take
update_failed.description: {name} was asked to install {target} but came back on {version}. Check its web page for details and try again.

set_remote_temperature.name: Set room temperature
set_remote_temperature.description: Gives a head the room temperature to regulate on, for a limited time.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: A climate (or any) entity of the HeatLink head.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Room temperature in °C. Leave empty to stop and use the unit's own reading.

ttl.name: Valid for
ttl.description: Seconds the head uses this value before falling back to its own reading. Send it again before then.
